messages:
sophie: FYI saw a crash in a staging customer flow after the new routing-policy header landed in the Python SDK. Looks like an init-order race that doubles quota attribution in console.

jamie: Ugh. Which flow? any logs? :grimacing:

sophie: it happens when client is created + immediately used in async context. Log snippet: 
```
ERROR ClientInit: route-mapper not ready, falling back
WARN quota: fallback attribution active (duplicate)
```

ara: Repro steps? I can try on my mac with py3.11.

sophie: quick repro: `pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.0rc2` then `await Client() ; await client.generate(prompt)` in a background task. 50% of runs show duplicate quota lines.

matt: Sounds like we call the policy handshake twice (once sync during import shim, once async during init). That could create two sampling tokens which console aggregates separately.

sophie: Exactly. Console sees two route headers so it creates two quasi-sessions.

olivia: Is TS/Go affected or just Py?

jamie: TS seems safe (we do lazy init there). Go probably OK but will audit.

ara: Minimal fix idea: make the python client idempotent for handshake: guard with `asyncio.Lock()` + check `self._handshake_done` flag before emitting headers. Patch shouldn't change public API.

matt: + add integration test that spins up local policy shim and asserts single header per request. We should also add a short-lived console dedupe rule as a knob in case patch takes time.

olivia: Could we roll a tiny patch release (0.9.0rc3) and opt-in customers only? Need docs note about potential double attribution.

ci-bot: Build passed for branch `fix/py-init-race` (3/3). Tests: unit 128, integration 14.

jamie: ok prioritize: 1) small patch to make handshake idempotent 2) add integration test 3) console temporary dedupe (telemetry side) 4) rollout to staged orgs -> monitor dashboards

ara: I'll open PR for the Python guard now, include changelog entry.

matt: I'll add a console-side metric to count distinct route headers per request and set an alert if >1 spikes.

olivia: Ping me once patch is merged; I'll coordinate staged rollout with two alpha customers.

sophie: thanks all. If anyone oncall sees odd quota noise this weekend, this is probably it. Tag me. :pray:
